headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $13,000 to support media arts teaching at MetWest
summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund will provide funds to support staff of the Media Enterprise Alliance at KDOL-TV, which teaches media arts to MetWest and other high school students and connects them to internships and paid jobs. The contract runs August 12, 2019 to May 28, 2020 and pays up to $13,000. The contract period began before this vote. The contract includes a COVID-19 amendment; the text does not say what it changes.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Civic Productions LLC - Fremont High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Civic Productions LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to connect Fremont Architecture and Media Academies to the following East Oakland Projects - Brooklyn Basin, Mid Pen Affordable Housing Development Exterior and Interior Art Installation, Old Oakland Farmers Market, Winter Artist Market and ongoing pop up shop, Vending booth, Community Cabins for the unhoused, 100 planters project, and Chinatown senior home furniture project at Fremont High School, for the period of February 24, 2020 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $12,000.00 and COVID Amendment thereto.
headline: Ratifies up to $12,000 for Civic Productions to link Fremont High students to East Oakland projects
summary: The district is paying Civic Productions LLC, an Oakland company, up to $12,000 to connect Fremont High School's Architecture and Media Academies to local art, design and community projects. The projects include a mural installation at an affordable housing development, a farmers market and a planters project. The contract period started February 24, 2020, before the Board's vote, and runs through June 30, 2020. The approval also covers a COVID-related amendment, which this item does not describe.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Maker Ed - Community Schools and Student Services Department

title: Professional Services Contract - Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc - Allendale Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Attitudinal Healing Connection, Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide: consultant will work collaboratively to share with and educate students, families, and staff about the services provided by both the partner agency and the school site through school meetings, events, school site plan, and site-based and partner agency marketing materials at Allendale Elementary School for the period of August 1, 2019 through August 1, 2020 in an amount not to exceed $27,000.00 and COVID Amendment thereto.

The approval also covers a COVID-related amendment, which this item does not describe.

title: Professional Services Contract - Catapult Learning - Strategic Resource Planning Department

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Bay Area Community Resources - Oakland International High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to provide support for Tier 1 and Tier 2 socio-emotional interventions for OIHS’s newly arrived immigrant students grappling with the adverse impacts of poverty and trauma, including: 1) In-depth student orientations and wellness checks as new students enroll in OIHS 2) Mentorship services, connections to caring adults and peer leaders 3) Early connections to behavioral health interventions - in advance of crisis situations. 4) Ongoing “Wellness Checks” for students struggling with behavioral health issues, and follow-up case management at Oakland International High School, for the period of August 21, 2019 through July 15, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $14,000.00 and COVID Amendment thereto.
headline: Approves up to $14,000 for Bay Area Community Resources to support newcomers at Oakland International High
summary: Bay Area Community Resources, of San Rafael, will provide wellness checks, mentoring and early connections to behavioral health help for newly arrived immigrant students at Oakland International High School, for up to $14,000. The contract period began August 21, 2019, before the Board's vote, and runs through July 15, 2020. The approval also covers a COVID-related amendment, which this item does not describe.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Sandy Spin Slade dba Skillastics - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Sandy Spin Slade dba Skillastics, Corona, CA, for the latter to provide: contractor will train District's Expanded Learning team as well as after school staff from 75 school sites with After School Education and Safety (ASES) or 21st Century grants around conducting mandated after school physical activities in manner compliant with CDE requirements via Community Schools and Student Services Department for the period of April 1, 2020 through June 30, 2020 in an amount not to exceed $2,598.00 and COVID Amendment thereto.

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Playworks - New Highland Academy Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Playworks, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide: the contractor, Playworks, will provide a full time TeamUp coach who will help facilitate positive play at recess, provide comprehensive on-site training and support in youth development, group management, and safety to the identified school site Noon Supervisor. Playworks coordinator, will train Noon Supervisor and student Junior coaches in healthy play and physical activities for all enrolled elementary-age students. Playworks TeamUp Coordinator will be on-site for five-days each month to model and teach fair and cooperative strategies, games, and systems to develop and sustain a positive educational culture for everyone, starting at recess at New Highland Academy (ES) for the period of January 6, 2020 through March 13, 2020 in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00 and COVID Amendment thereto.

It will also train the school's noon supervisor and student junior coaches, for up to $10,000. The work period was January 6 to March 13, 2020, which was before the Board's vote. The approval also covers a COVID-related amendment, which this item does not describe.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Reading Partners, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide: consultant will support enrolled students which will receive a minimum of 12 sessions. Students will complete research-validated literacy lessons focused on phonics, phonemic awareness, and comprehension skills at Emerson Elementary School for the period of August 12, 2019 through May 28, 2020 in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00 and COVID Amendment thereto.

The program works on reading, writing, speaking and math skills. It runs June 8 to June 30, 2020. The approval also covers a COVID-related amendment, which this item does not describe.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Termination - Memorandum of Understanding - Galileo Learning - Community Partnerships - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text: Acceptance by the Board of Education of the voluntary termination, effective May 16, 2020, of the Memorandum of Understanding, No Cost between the District and Galileo Learning, Oakland, CA, by the latter, pursuant to termination clause of Agreement, to provide summer enrichment activities and science education, as described in the Scope of Work, at Chabot Elementary School, for the period of June 1, 2018 through August 30, 2020, due to the unforeseen COVID-19 Pandemic.
